_doc: P3255d (t824u chunk 3): bot [skip ci] data commits aimed at master go to the rolling branch bot/data; bot-data-fold.yml squashes it into ONE master commit per day. Only commits whose files are ALL under deferPaths are diverted; anything else (app.json, lib, drivers, publish state) still goes straight to master. Disable with enabled=false or env BOT_BATCH=0.
